NaamShaktiProfile.title: Naam Shakti Profile
NaamShaktiProfile.description: Stores a user's anime warrior progress, real Naam Jap unlocked Shakti Energy, KO recovery state, upgrades, and mission milestones.

unlockedWarriorsCsv.description: Comma-separated list of unlocked warrior IDs

unlockedBattlefield.description: Whether 10,000 Naam Jap unlock milestone has been achieved

koRecoveryActive.description: Whether the warrior is in Shakti Recovery Mode (energy depleted to 0)

currentShaktiEnergy.description: Current remaining Shakti Energy strictly derived from real Naam Jap

lifetimeShaktiEarned.description: Total lifetime Shakti Energy earned from real Naam Jap

lifetimeShaktiSpent.description: Total lifetime Shakti Energy spent in lightning battles

syncedAllTimeNaam.description: All-time real Naam Jap count last converted to Shakti

koBaselineAllTimeNaam.description: All-time real Naam Jap snapshot at KO to require 1,000 new Naam for revive

warriorXp.description: Earned battle XP for character upgrades

NaamJapDayRecord.title: Naam Jap Day Record
NaamJapDayRecord.description: Cloud backup of a user's daily real Naam Jap count and target.

count.description: Real Naam Jap count recorded on this day

goalAtDay.description: Daily Naam Jap target on this day

ShaktiHistoryEvent.title: Shakti History Event
ShaktiHistoryEvent.description: Ledger entry recording Naam Jap unlocks, Shakti energy spent in battle, KO recovery, revives, and warrior upgrades.

subtitle.description: Details about the battle or Naam Jap energy record

naamCountSnapshot.description: All-time Naam Jap count at event time

/users/{userId}/naam_shakti/{docId}.description: Owner-only NAAM SHAKTI warrior profile and real Shakti energy state.

/users/{userId}/naam_jap_days/{dateKey}.description: Owner-only cloud synced daily real Naam Jap counts.

/users/{userId}/shakti_history/{eventId}.description: Owner-only append-only ledger of Naam Jap and game Shakti Energy events.
